name: knee-pushups.html
instructions:
1. Set up for the knee push-up in the same way you'd set up for a regular push-up, only your lower body will rest on your knees and not your feet. Your body should still be straight.
2. Lower your body towards the floor until your torso is about 1 inch from the floor. Pause, then slowly raise your body back to the starting position.
3. Repeat for desired reps.
